description: This Java class 'MidiDispatcher' is a utility for dispatching MIDI data to a list of MidiReceiver objects. It manages a list of receivers, allows adding and removing them via a MidiSender, and forwards MIDI messages to all connected receivers, removing any receiver that throws an IOException during message sending. It extends the MidiReceiver class, overriding methods for sending and flushing MIDI data.
external_methods: MidiReceiver.send(byte[] msg, int offset, int count, long timestamp)

classes.name: MidiDispatcher
classes.description: A class that manages a list of MidiReceiver instances and dispatches MIDI data to all registered receivers. It provides methods for retrieving receiver count, obtaining a MidiSender for managing receivers, and overriding send and flush methods to handle MIDI message distribution and error handling.

methods.name: getReceiverCount
methods.description: Returns the number of MidiReceiver instances currently registered with the dispatcher.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns a MidiSender object used to add or remove MidiReceiver instances from the dispatcher.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides the MidiReceiver's onSend method to forward MIDI messages to all registered receivers, removing any that throw an IOException.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Overrides the MidiReceiver's flush method to instruct all registered receivers to flush their data.
